tasks.title: Set up Kafka infrastructure with Docker Compose in KRaft mode

subtasks.title: Implement Error Handling and Circuit Breaker Pattern
subtasks.description: Implement error handling mechanisms and integrate a circuit breaker pattern to handle Kafka connection and publishing failures.

subtasks.title: Idempotency and Duplicate Prevention Logic

subtasks.details:

<info added on 2025-06-24T10:09:49.355Z>
Added idempotency and duplicate prevention logic to createWorkoutEntry. Before creating a new entry, the function queries the Notion database for an existing entry with the same type, sets, reps, weight, and today's date. If a duplicate is found, it logs and skips creation. Otherwise, it proceeds with entry creation and retry logic. This ensures no duplicate entries are created for the same workout log on the same day.
